description_en: Cancels a certificate application order that is pending domain verification or under review
description_zh: 撤回待验证、审核中的证书申请订单
name: CancelOrderRequest

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the certificate order to cancel.

Obtain this ID by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455804.html
parameters.help_zh:
订单ID。
此ID可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/455804.html获取
parameters.name: order_id

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique ID for each request. Use this ID to troubleshoot and locate problems
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
